The '''Duck Feather''' is an [[:Category:Animal Products|animal product]] obtained from a [[Duck]] with sufficient [[Animals#Friendship|friendship]], [[Animals#Mood|mood]], and [[Luck|daily luck]]. It can also occasionally be purchased from the [[Traveling Cart]] for {{Tprice|250}}. Additionally, if the player is married to [[Emily]], she will occasionally gift one to the player. The [[Statue Of Endless Fortune]] produces one Duck Feather on [[Leo]]'s birthday, [[Summer|Summer 26]], provided the Player has met [[Leo]]. It can also be gifted by a [[Animals#Pets|pet]] cat with max [[Animals#Friendship|friendship]].

[[Luck#Luck Buffs|Luck buffs]] do not influence the chances of getting a duck feather.

==Bundles==
Duck Feather is used in the {{Bundle|dye||y}}.

==Recipes==
Duck Feather is not used in any recipes.

==Tailoring==
Duck Feather is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] with [[Cloth]] in the feed to create a {{Name|Shirt012|link=Tailoring{{!}}Lime Green Striped Shirt|class=inline}}. It is a green dye when used in the spool of the Sewing Machine with a dyeable clothing item in the feed. It can be placed in the green dye pot at Emily's and Haley's house for use in [[dyeing]].

==Quests==
Duck Feather is not used in any [[Quests|quests]].
